caption:
Ten years of the wrong pillow can wreck your mornings, and most people never trace it back to the pillow.

Stacking two pillows, rolling a towel under your neck, switching sides mid-night, reaching for a memory foam block that turns your head into a sweat puddle — none of it fixes the real issue: a standard pillow isn't shaped for a shoulder.

The Eli & Elm Side Sleeper Pillow is built around that shoulder instead of ignoring it — a U-shape cutout for queen-size sleepers, an adjustable latex-and-fiber fill, and a cooling cover made to stay cool through the night.

At $114.99, it's a one-time fix for a problem you've been patching around for years — no more towel rolls, no more flipped pillows, no more waking up stiff.
